senses.definition: simple past and past participle of sit
examples: I sat in the middle of the park.
Jill sat Jack down for a talk.
We sat ourselves down for dinner.
The children were sat at a low table. (informal; chiefly UK/Commonwealth)

quotes.text: Hold on, I’m sat on my arse while I’m writing this.
quotes.reference: 2007, Tony Bell, “eighteen”, in Life in the Bus Lane, Cambridge: Vanguard Press, →ISBN, page 103:

senses.definition: Abbreviation of satori (“a mutant gene of Drosophila, a genus of fruit flies, that causes homosexual behaviour in males (specifically, courtship directed to other males)”).
Abbreviation of satoshi (“a hundred-millionth of a bitcoin”).
Level of saturation (especially of oxygen in the blood).

quotes.text: Also, your blood pressure and oxygen sats – that's the amount of oxygen in your blood.
quotes.reference: 2010, Virginia Allum, Patricia McGarr, Cambridge English for Nursing Pre-intermediate Student's Book with Audio CD, Cambridge University Press, →ISBN, page 93:

quotes.text: [T]his is her third admission for breathing difficulties. The first two admissions we managed to control her and discharge her home with her mum. This time we can't get her oxygen sats up—they're actually falling.
